definitions.explanation: The elected head of a Japanese prefecture (県), responsible for governing prefectural affairs. Japan has 43 prefectures designated as 県, each headed by a 県知事.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{県知事|けんちじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: A new prefectural governor was elected.

examples.japanese: {県知事|けんちじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記者|きしゃ}{会見|かいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The prefectural governor held a press conference.

examples.japanese: {県知事|けんちじ}{選挙|せんきょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立候補|りっこうほ}→立候補：13778_rikkouho⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The gubernatorial election is scheduled for next month, with three candidates running.

notes:
The governor of a Japanese prefecture (⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧). Japan has 47 prefectures, of which 43 are ⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧. The remaining four use different designations: {都|と} (Tokyo), {道|どう} (Hokkaido), and ⟦{府|ふ}→府：09870_fu⟧ (Osaka and Kyoto). Their governors are called {都知事|とちじ}, {道知事|どうちじ}, and {府知事|ふちじ} respectively.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {県知事|けんちじ}{選挙|せんきょ}: gubernatorial election
- {県知事|けんちじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as prefectural governor
- ⟦{現|げん}→現〜：03950_gen⟧{県知事|けんちじ}: the current prefectural governor

- {都知事|とちじ} — governor of Tokyo
